.s4af-wrap h1 { font-size: 2em; color: #002347; border-left: 5px solid #FF6600; padding-left: 14px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.s4af-wrap h2 { font-size: 1.35em; color: #002347; border-bottom: 2px solid #FF6600; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-top: 40px; }
.s4af-wrap h3 { font-size: 1.1em; color: #FF6600; margin-top: 24px; }
.s4af-wrap p { margin: 10px 0 14px; }
.s4af-wrap hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e6ef; margin: 36px 0; }
.s4af-wrap a { color: #004aad; text-decoration: none; }
.s4af-wrap a:hover { color: #FF6600; text-decoration: underline; }
.s4af-wrap ul, .s4af-wrap ol { padding-left: 24px; margin: 10px 0 14px; }
.s4af-wrap li { margin-bottom: 5px; }
.s4af-wrap .subtitle { color: #64748b; font-size: 0.95em; margin-bottom: 20px; }

/* Tables */
.s4af-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 16px 0; font-size: 0.95em; }
.s4af-wrap thead tr { background: #002347; color: #fff; }
.s4af-wrap thead th { padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; }
.s4af-wrap tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f0f4f9; }
.s4af-wrap tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: #fff; }
.s4af-wrap tbody td { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e6ef; vertical-align: top; }
.s4af-wrap tbody tr:hover { background: #e6edf7; }
.s4af-wrap .overview-table tbody td:first-child { font-weight: 600; color: #002347; width: 38%; }

/* Expandable sections */
.s4af-wrap details { margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d0d7e2; }
.s4af-wrap details summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 20px; background: #002347; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1em; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; user-select: none; border-radius: 7px; transition: background 0.2s; }
.s4af-wrap details[open] summary { background: #003d7a; border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0; }
.s4af-wrap details summary:hover { background: #004a96; }
.s4af-wrap details summary::after { content: '▼'; font-size: 0.75em; transition: transform 0.25s; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 12px; }
.s4af-wrap details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.s4af-wrap details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.s4af-wrap .details-body { padding: 18px 20px; background: #fff; }

/* FAQ */
.s4af-wrap .faq-item summary { background: #f5f7fa; color: #002347; border-left: 4px solid #FF6600; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; }
.s4af-wrap .faq-item[open] summary { background: #eef2f8; border-radius: 0 6px 0 0; }
.s4af-wrap .faq-item summary:hover { background: #e6edf7; }
.s4af-wrap .faq-item .details-body { background: #fafbfd; border: 1px solid #e0e6ef; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px; }

/* Blockquote */
.s4af-wrap blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #FF6600; background: #fff8f3; margin: 16px 0; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; color: #4a3800; font-size: 0.95em; }

/* Tip / Info box */
.s4af-wrap .tip-box { background: #f0f6ff; border-left: 4px solid #002347; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 14px 0; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; }
.s4af-wrap .tip-box strong { color: #002347; }

/* Other Opportunities — card style */
.s4af-wrap .s4af-related-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-related-card { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #f0f4f9; border: 1px solid #d0d7e2; border-radius: 8px; color: #002347; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9em; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-related-card:hover { background: #002347; color: #fff !important; border-color: #002347; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-related-card i { color: #FF6600; font-size: 0.9em; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* Footer note */
.s4af-wrap .footer-note { text-align: center; color: #64748b; font-size: 0.88em; margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 2px solid #FF6600; }
.s4af-wrap .footer-note strong { color: #FF6600; }

/* Social media footer */
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social { margin-top: 14px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social span { color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9em; margin-right: 4px; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.85em; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; color: #fff !important; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a:hover { opacity: 0.85; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a.s4af-fb { background: #1877F2; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a.s4af-yt { background: #FF0000; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a.s4af-tg { background: #0088cc; }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a.s4af-ig { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #f09433 0%, #e6683c 25%, #dc2743 50%, #cc2366 75%, #bc1888 100%); }
.s4af-wrap .s4af-social a.s4af-wa { background: #25D366; }

                                    <p>Applications are now open for the Eira Francis Davies Scholarship to international students for the academic year 2023/2024. Applicants from worldwide can apply for this opportunity at the <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://o4af.com/organization/swansea-university/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Swansea University</a></span></span> of United Kingdom if:</p>
<ul>
<li>They are a female student living in a developing country with academic excellence.</li>
<li>Willing to pursue their <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.o4af.com/opportunities?ajax_filter=true&per-page=30&sort-by=recent&degree=Master" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Master’s</a></span></span> degree in Health, Medicine, and Life science.</li>
</ul>
<p>Applicants should hold an offer letter for the following Master’s degree to apply to Eira Francis Davies <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.o4af.com/opportunities/?ajax_filter=true&per-page=30&sort-by=recent&job_type=scholarship" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Scholarship</a></span></span> in the United Kingdom:</p>
<ul>
<li>Biomedical Science (Clinical Biochemistry), MSc</li>
<li>Biomedical Science (Clinical Microbiology), MSc</li>
<li>Clinical Psychology and Mental Health, MSc</li>
<li>Cognitive Neuroscience, MSc</li>
<li>Genomic Medicine, MSc</li>
<li>Healthcare Management, MSc</li>
<li>Health Data Science, MSc</li>
<li>Health Informatics, MSc</li>
<li>Medical Neuroscience, MSc</li>
<li>Medical Radiation Physics, MSc</li>
<li>Nanomedicine, MSc</li>
<li>Public Health and Health Promotion, MSc</li>
<li>Research Methods in Psychology, MSc</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Important Note: </strong>Ineligible Eira Francis Davies Scholarship applicants can apply for <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/international-students/my-finances/international-scholarships/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">more scholarship opportunities</a></span></span>.</p>
<h2>Important Dates and Benefits</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Application Deadline:</strong>26 May 2024 11:59 pm (BST)</li>
<li><strong>Latest Invitation to Interview:</strong>14 June 2024</li>
<li><strong>Interviewing period:</strong>17– 21 June 2024</li>
<li><strong>Decisions: </strong>5th July 2024</li>
<li><strong>Host University:</strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://o4af.com/organization/swansea-university/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Swansea University</a></span></span></li>
<li><strong>Funding Type</strong><strong>:</strong>Full Tuition Fee</li>
<li><strong>Gender:</strong> Female Only</li>
<li><strong>Eligible Countries:</strong> <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/media/Eira-Francis-Davies-Eligible-Countries-2023.docx" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Developing Countries</a></span></span></li>
<li><strong>Degree </strong><strong>Level:</strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.o4af.com/opportunities?ajax_filter=true&per-page=30&sort-by=recent&degree=Master" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Master’s Degree</a></span></span></li>
<li><strong>Study Mode</strong><strong>:</strong> Full-Time Taught Programs</li>
</ul>
<h2> Eligibility Criteria for the Eira Francis Davies Scholarship</h2>
<p>Students with outstanding academic performance are eligible to apply if they meet the following requirements:</p>
<ul>
<li>Prove at least 2:1 <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;"><a style="color: #0000ff; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.o4af.com/opportunities?ajax_filter=true&per-page=30&sort-by=recent&degree=bachelor" target="_blank" rel="noopener">bachelor’s degree</a></span></span> or equivalent;</li>
<li>Apply to any of the Master mentioned above’s degree programs;</li>
<li>Be a female applicant;</li>
<li>Entering for the first time at Swansea University in September 2023;</li>
<li>Be in financial need and provide financial plan and motivation to study their desired program at the University;</li>
<li>Demonstrate strong academic ability;</li>
<li>Should not receive any other financial funding from Swansea University, including tuition fee reduction, scholarship, or bursary;</li>
